_help: A-13 durability (scripts/Durability.cs; smith UI in scripts/UiSmithRepair.cs). max: an item's most durability = (byRarity[rarity] + perLevel x item level) x slotMul[slot] x (1 + perUpgrade x hone level); a slot not listed in slotMul (trinket) has no durability. wear: points lost; weaponPerHit = per melee swing that lands, rangedPerShot = per shot or throw, armorPerHit = every worn armor piece per blow taken, shieldPerBlock = the shield (or off-hand weapon) per blocked blow on top, deathPct = % of max lost by everything worn on death. All wear x (1 + wearP%) (Endurance lowers it). low = the share at which the HUD warns. At 0 the item stays worn but gives no stats (a weapon hits as bare hands) until repaired. tierBar: the metal bar a repair needs, by rarity. smelt: smith recipes {out: material id, n: bars made, in: {material: count}, gold}. repair: a full repair (100% missing) costs bars[rarity] of the tier bar + extraBySlot (weapons: extraByType first) + extraByRarity[rarity] + goldPerPoint[rarity] x missing points x (1 + goldPerLevel x item level); a partial repair costs the same share, rounded up (at least 1 bar). Material ids are data/gather.json materials.
